title: Field of Screams
start: Talk to the founding members of The Horsemen in the Harvest Hollow.

recommended.t: Archaeology journal (for teleport to the Archaeology Guild to access the Exam Centre)
Air altar teleport to the air altar, or skills necklace or modified sous chef's toque teleport to the Cooks' Guild for quick access to Gertrude's house
Ring of respawn teleport to the White Knights' Castle (if you completed Recruitment Drive)

rewards.t: The Horsemen's Uniform of chosen captain
Horses the chicken pet, themed around chosen captain
10,000 spooky tokens (capable of surpassing the soft cap of 150,000 spooky tokens)
Emotes from the previous Halloween events (if not unlocked)
Ability to hand in clan confections for further rewards

steps.t: Talk to Death, Famine, Frank, Pestilence, or War in the Harvest Hollow. [Chat: Accept]
p: The founding members of The Horsemen

steps.t: Wear or enable as a cosmetic override four components from the above table. If wearing an item, you must not override its slot with a cosmetic override.
Talk again to one of Death, Famine, Frank, Pestilence, or War. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Can you check my outfit?] (This choice will affect the quest's rewards.)
Talk to the clan representative just outside of Gertrude's house.
Talk to Gertrude.
Talk to the clan representative again.
Talk to the clan representative in the floor 1 of the east side of the White Knights' Castle outside the room where Sir Renitee and Ambassador Spanfipple are.
Talk to Ambassador Spanfipple.

Head back downstairs, go to the west stairs of the castle, go upstairs, and investigate the suit of armour. (The correct suits of armour in this step and following steps periodically say RSChat | Teehee! and are marked with a quest icon in their tooltip.)
p: Place: Suit of armour (Field of Screams)

steps.t: Head back downstairs, climb the ladder on the north-east side of the castle to get to the floor 2. Investigate the suit of armour to the south-east.
Go downstairs back to floor 0, then head to the east side to investigate the suit of armour. [Chat: 1 Trick.]
Go up the ladder to the east and talk to Ambassador Spanfipple.
Talk to the clan representative.
Talk to the clan representative on the floor 2 of Lumbridge Castle outside Duke Horacio's room.
Read duke's dream diary on a table in the south-eastern corner of the room.
Talk to the cook downstairs.
Talk to any examiner in Exam Centre for a quiz. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Answer three questions correctly. (The questions are randomly selected and may not be in the following order.)

sub.t: "True or false: bronze, silver and mithril are all types of ferrous dragon." [Chat: 2 False.]
"What are the three main classifications of dragon?" [Chat: 3 Chromatic, ferrous, and gemstone.]
"Which of these is the weakest type of dragon?" [Chat: 1 Black.]
"Which of these would not protect you against dragonfire?" [Chat: 3 Dragonstones.]

steps.t: Talk to the cook.
Talk to Duke Horacio.
Talk to the clan representative.
Talk to the captain you chose earlier in Harvest Hollow (either Death, Famine, Frank, Pestilence, or War).
If you haven't completed Maize Maze before:

sub.t: Talk to the captain you chose earlier.

steps.t: Quest complete!

p: Map of the maze, showing all starting locations (yellow squares), the routes to the centre (red arrows and lines), and the doors into the boss room (blue) from its perimeter corridor (yellow line)

get_inside.text: Casting Harvest Hollow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network
Teleporting with the Harvest Hollow entry in the Calendar or Community events interface
Entering the Harvest Hollow portal in the northern Grand Exchange
Entering the Holiday portal in Prifddinas
Teleporting with town criers
Maize Maze
Main | Maize Maze

Players must work their way through an ever-changing maze, catching implings for weapons to spook the enemies in the maze while avoiding or defeating skeletons and zombies in order to get to the centre, where a Halloween-themed version of an in-game boss can be fought.
Defeating the boss awards 700 spooky tokens and some Maize Maze spoils depending on the currently active boss and the number of double and triple loot points the player has.
Strange and golden rocks for Agility can be found by jumping over the obstacles in the maze and for Hunter by catching the implings.
Graveyard
Players may find different skilling activities for Archaeology, Farming, Prayer, Summoning and Thieving whilst engaging with the graveyard in the Harvest Hollow.
Mystery remains primarily for Archaeology
Pumpkin patches for Farming (after completing Guys and Dolls quest.)
Coffins and mausoleums primarily for Thieving
Summoning circle primarily for Summoning
Handing in Ancient remains for Prayer
Players may obtain spooky tokens from the activities. For hourly rates of obtaining spooky tokens, see Sl | Spooky tokens | #Estimated hourly rates .

Eep can be used to hand in artefacts to complete the Horrible Hollow Histories collection, as well as the bones received from the ancient remains to complete the Bounty of Bones collection in return for spooky tokens. Also, players can hand in ancient valuables and ancient heirlooms to Peckish for spooky tokens. Lastly, the various gourds from the pumpkin patches can be handed into the harvest cart to fulfil Dolly's pumpkin orders to receive spooky tokens.
Strange and golden rocks for Farming can be found by depositing pumpkins into the harvest cart.
Stage
The reward shops in the area are located in front of the stage. Scuffle and the Maize Maze portal are located north of the stage.
Bonfire

The bonfire may be used like any other bonfire, granting firemaking experience for adding logs. It will also provide spooky tokens with every log and has a chance to grant ancient remains when logs are added. Once Guys and Dolls has been completed, special coloured logs provided by Guy can be used instead.
The bank chest in the area are located north-east of the bonfire.

West of the bonfire is a field with five yaks with four of them being zombie yaks while the fifth is a living one ("An average yak", according to the examine). All of them wander in the field except the biggest one which is standing in front of the fence, close to one of the two drinking troughs, and is "an aggressive yak", again according to the examine. The remaining three zombie yaks are the same size and are "hungry", "sickly", or "dead". Judging from their examine texts, each one pulls one of the five caravans by the bonfire and is therefore associated with one of the Horsemen: Death ("dead"), Famine ("hungry"), Frank ("average"), Pestilence ("sickly"), and War ("aggressive").
Death's mansion
Main | Death's mansion
Death's mansion is located in the Harvest Hollow currently. A gate is blocking the way to the mansion.
